items.title: Transforming AI models into useful model organisms
items.description: These systems were not built to explain the brain. But treating them as model organisms that we can perturb and evolve will move us closer to that goal.

items.title: Models at the speed of thought: How AI coding is reshaping theoretical neuroscience
items.description: Agentic coding makes it possible to specify a neuroscience model in hours instead of months. Seven neuroscientists weigh in on what that tectonic change may bring to the field.
